nativeValidation.setup: Use a clean non-production checkout at the stated revision. Run commands from the repository root in the same non-elevated PowerShell session. After the first command, copy the ZIP to files.copyTo. Preserve the three test logs.
commands: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne '12cafe67250b865cfc87c86cc600d3d8b2b42887') { throw 'Unexpected validation revision' }; if ((go env GOOS).Trim() -ne 'windows') { throw 'Set Go to target native Windows' }; $scratch = (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.t3-tmp/windows-edition-selection' -Force).FullName; $temp = (New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $scratch 'tmp') -Force).FullName; $env:TEMP = $temp; $env:TMP = $temp; $env:GOTMPDIR = $temp

go test '-v' '-count=1' './cmds/ownsand-agent/internal/imagebuild' '-run' '^TestSelectEdition$' 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $scratch 'native-fixture.log'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows edition selection test failed' }; $fixtureLog = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $scratch 'native-fixture.log') -Raw; if ($fixtureLog -notmatch '(?m)^--- PASS: TestSelectEdition \(') { throw 'TestSelectEdition did not run' }

$archive = Join-Path $scratch 'selector-regression-overlays.zip'; if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $archive).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne '9da43bc8a64b178c82f34a197ea0fcc08b4eb3920e29741a0449e98360389556') { throw 'Unexpected selector overlay archive' }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $scratch -Force
expectedResults: The native TestSelectEdition run exits 0. The ten subtests pass. Empty input selects the second listed image at index 1. Exact mixed-case and uppercase names select indices 1 and 4. The unique folded name selects index 1. The ambiguous folded name returns an error.

The first-entry overlay makes the test exit 1 with only default_index failing. The first-folded overlay makes the test exit 1 with only exact_mixed-case_name and ambiguous_folded_name failing. The PowerShell checks accept exactly these results.
outOfScope: WIM or ISO enumeration, applying real installation media, and Hyper-V image-build acceptance.
